title: Expose the shared image workflow through Papyrus MCP
description:
As an editor working with an agent, I want the MCP server to offer the same image operations as the CLI so that I can review or delegate image choices in a conversation.

Feature: Image curation through MCP
  Scenario: Discover and select image candidates
    Given an authorized MCP client connected to a site
    When it requests image candidates and applies one to an item
    Then it receives the same candidate identity, metadata and saved result as the shared service and CLI
  Scenario: A site permission is missing
    Given an MCP client without permission to update the item
    When it attempts to apply an image
    Then the operation is denied and the item remains unchanged
  Scenario: Generation is unavailable
    Given the publication has no generation provider configured
    When an MCP client requests generation
    Then the tool returns an actionable error without invoking a provider

Integrate with the in-progress authenticated MCP implementation and its site-bound permissions. Do not create a second image workflow or bypass existing authentication.
